# dgdedge — Executive Coaching & Advisory

> One-to-one executive coaching and advisory work for leaders and leadership teams, led by Dennis Daniels. Based in Dubai, UAE.

## Core Summary

dgdedge provides high-impact executive coaching, advisory workshops, and practical AI adoption guidance for experienced executives who want sharper judgment, clear communication, and reduced cognitive load under pressure.

## Dennis Daniels

- **Background**: 25+ years across education, university lecturing (Sorbonne Nouvelle – Paris III), corporate training, IT sales, and business ownership (Partner in Onlink Services, 2007–2019).
- **Focus**: Practical, people-first coaching focused on real accountability, decision-making costs, and communication under pressure.
